source_excerpts.text:
6. COMBINED MANY-BODY THEOREM: COORDINATES AND BITS
================================================
Suppose the acquired block partition has |C|<=B at all times by the preceding
physical rule. All observations are retained. At the end of each declared
sweep, each site independently undergoes the physical channel
  e(X)=(1-r0)X+r0 I_d/d Tr X,       0<r0<1.
Its replacement labels remain private. A finite number/description size of
operations between sweeps is required to bound working arithmetic.

Within a block of s sites, the channel has a positive decomposition
  e^tensor_s = r0^s R_(I/d^s)+(1-r0^s)G_s,
where G_s is CPTP. This is used to prove a bound; the observer does not
sample or receive these hidden reset choices. It propagates the local
channel directly on its represented block.

The block's eigenvalue floor and contraction are
  a_s=(r0/d)^s,
  q_s=(1-r0^s)/[1-r0^s+2(r0/d)^s] <= q_B <1.

The important product identity is
  h(tensor_C rho_C,tensor_C sigma_C)=sum_C h(rho_C,sigma_C).
Every same-record operation between sweeps is globally nonexpansive, even
when the common partition changes. At the sweep, each block contracts by
at most q_B. Quantizing each refreshed block at mesh delta gives

  H_(n+1) <= q_B H_n + 2delta (N/B)(d^2/r0)^B.

Here sum_C d^(2|C|) <= (N/B)d^(2B), because d^(2s)/s increases with integer
s. No divisibility of N by B is needed. With legitimate H_0=0,

  D_tr(rho_n,rhohat_n)
    <= N (d^2/r0)^B delta / [2B(1-q_B)]              (MAIN)

for every supported complete received history, uniformly in n. The same
allowance bounds the current state during intervening branches, and every
common future physical experiment started from the encoded state.

The state uses at most (N/B)d^(2B) independent real integer coordinates,
each with b+2 bits, plus derived or cached trace normalizers. A sufficient
precision is
  b >= ceil log2[N (d^2/r0)^B / (2B(1-q_B)epsilon)].
Also satisfy delta<=1/(4d^B). Partition labels use, for example,O(Nlog N)
bits; controller and model memory remain separate. Rational work between
sweeps is finite with an explicit dependence on B, local model precision,
the number of primitive operations and b, rather than elapsed record age.

Thus for fixed d,B,r0 and tolerance, state coordinate count is linear in N,
and precision grows logarithmically with N/epsilon. The theorem is still

source.quote: The block structure is a property of the declared acquired physical
source.range_scope: Physical cut updates and conditional block partition proof.

source_excerpts.text:
* Actual visible local operations keep the conditional physical state in
    a product of blocks of at most B sites.
  * Genuinely private noise contracts order errors, permitting a fixed-bit
    positive representation of every block while marked acquisition and
    controlled interactions continue.

The block structure is a property of the declared acquired physical
experiment, not an unproved factorization of an arbitrary posterior. All
observers receive every mark, cut operation and control. This is a changed
physical protocol, and the cost to the scientific/control objective of
breaking correlations must be assessed separately from simulation error.

1. A product partition that can be maintained from received information
======================================================================
There are N sites of local dimension d>=2. At the beginning of a sweep the
conditional state has the represented form

  rho_h = tensor_(C in P_h) rho_(C,h),    |C|<=B.

The exact observer and computational observer share the partition P_h.
It can be maintained without pretending to observe hidden bath events:

  * An instrument or gate confined to one block updates that block.
  * A gate joining two blocks merges their labels and their density matrix.
  * A visible local measure-and-prepare outcome at site v separates v from
    the REST of its current block. In the simple rank-one projective case,
    the outcome prepares a known pure state at v.

For a general declared local cut instrument
  C_y(X)=tau_y tr(F_y X),    sum_y F_y=I,
the joint conditional output is tau_y at v tensored with the conditional
state of the rest. The operation is physical, received and paid for. It is
not a software deletion of correlations. The rest of the old block must
be kept as one block unless a separate factorization proof is available:
measuring a connecting site can entangle the remaining sites. Graph
disconnection alone is insufficient.

Before a gate whose merged block would exceed B, a declared controller
may cut one or both endpoints and then perform the gate, choosing enough
cuts to satisfy the size cap. This maintains a product partition using
actual operations and their marks. The controller's partition labels and
any policy state must be retained and counted. Adaptive choices may use
the computational observer: the exact same-record comparator uses those
actual choices,

source_excerpts.text:
Executed records:4096 model-generated steps,512 constant++ steps and512
alternating-sign steps, each at four precisions. On the4096-step reference,
maximum observed trace error was6.09664e-8 and next-record TV error2.90584e-8.
The dense reference and these observed errors use ordinary floating arithmetic;
the uniform allowance is instead proved by the exact positive update/rounding
operation. The actual finite output is finite_bit_observer_state.json.

B. Acquired local blocks under independent onsite noise
----------------------------------------------------
local_cut_noisy_observer.py combines the active endpoint rule, non-Clifford
controlled rotations, ongoing local X/Z weak marks, independent onsite
private refresh1/4, and exact Fraction updates with positive dyadic rounding.
The separate dense reference receives the same physical marks and controls.

For N4,B2,b34, q_B=30/31 and the uniform global trace allowance is
  31/67108864 =4.6193599700927734375e-7.
The run completed512 sweeps,2048 weak marks and510 visible endpoint cuts.
The largest block had2 sites and the maximum independent coordinate count
was32. The core bound is1152 bits, before model/partition/controller/work.
Maximum observed global trace error against the floating dense reference
was1.04473e-9; maximum binary prediction error was5.69707e-10. Observed exact
intermediate fraction numerator/denominator size was98 bits; this observed
maximum is not itself the all-record working bound.
An independent exact audit also supplies a deliberately loose all-record
core arithmetic cap of496 magnitude bits at b34, excluding diagnostics.

The actual positive product state and finite controller state are saved in
finite_positive_block_output.json. The simulation transcript is retained
for reproduction, but the observer operation does not retain that transcript.
These are supplied-model calculations, not laboratory acquisition.

C. Exact blind-spot controls and independent checks
-------------------------------------------------
The visible-cut code independently propagates a full four-qubit Fraction
density matrix and an acquired block filter on every enumerated word.
There are292 exact state comparisons and48 exact next-outcome comparisons;
the complete record probabilities sum to1. A B3 overflow requires one
endpoint cut, while B2 requires two. All16 readout words of an initially

statement: For a finite-dimensional lattice with a supplied block partition of maximum size B maintained by visible local measure-and-prepare cuts, apply independent private full-rank onsite replacement noise after each sweep. Under the stated finite-operation and model conditions, a positive block-state observer maintains a uniform trace-distance allowance for every supported current record and for future physical experiments started from the encoded state. The state uses at most (N/B)d^(2B) independent real coordinates, with sufficient precision growing logarithmically in N and inverse tolerance when d, B and noise strength are fixed. Dependence on B remains exponential.
